resources.string: Automatically taps “Skip” in the YouTube app and, if you want, mutes the sound during ads. The service sees only YouTube windows and sends no data anywhere.
A settings screen will open. Tap ⋮ in the top right corner, then “Allow restricted settings”, and come back here.
Turn on the AdSkipper switch and tap “Allow”. You will come back here automatically.
YouTube ads will now be skipped automatically. You only need to do this once: it stays on after restarts and updates.
